messages.subject: choosing method in geom_smooth
parts:
Hello,

I'm doing graphics like this.

lmfit <- geom_smooth(method="lm")

p1 <- qplot(x, y, data=Tab) + facet_grid(id ~., scales = "free") +
lmfit


So I have a lot of graphics, each for different id. For each of them I
traced lineaire equation y=ax+b. But I have graphics that another
equation will be better for them, somethimes it is parabola equation :
y=ax^2+bx+c or somethimes it is exponentiel equation y=a*exp(-b*x)+c

For summarize: I want to trace for each graphic one of that 3
equations, an equation that fit better then others.

Is it possible to do it?
How can I know wich equation is the best one? with R²?

Can you help me please?

Thank you

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: choosing method in geom_smooth
parts:
Hi Sav,

A reproducible example
(https://github.com/hadley/devtools/wiki/Reproducibility) always makes
it more likely that you'll get an answer. But in brief: fit all three
models and then pick the "best" using whatever criteria makes most
sense for your problem.

Hadley
